mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (real GDP growth) signals robust demand, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, driving positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) during periods of rising GDPC1, or Rank IC <0.05 over 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing risk premium and driving negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% for >6 months without triggering negative 20-day returns, or returns revert positively within 30 days post-crossing.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and monthly PAYEMS (labor) indicate robust economic expansion, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, driving positive 5-day forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and PAYEMS rises simultaneously
failure_condition: GDPC1 and PAYEMS rise together but 5-day returns remain negative, or their combined effect is offset by other factors (e.g., high inflation).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals potential overheating, prompting investors to anticipate tighter monetary policy and sell equities, driving negative 60-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative for >60% of the 60-day horizon despite CPIAUCSL rising in late-cycle expansion, or revert positively within 30 days post-inflation spike.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 4.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and equity valuations, driving negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 4.0% for >6 months without triggering negative 20-day returns, or returns revert positively within 30 days post-unemployment rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply index) reflects robust production growth, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive 60-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive during periods of rising INDPRO over the 60-day horizon, or Rank IC <0.05 over 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in FEDFUNDS and rises in INDPRO signal accommodative monetary policy and robust supply growth, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, driving positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls while INDPRO rises simultaneously
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and INDPRO move inversely but 20-day returns remain negative, or their combined effect is offset by other factors (e.g., high inflation).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly increases in GDPC1 (real GDP growth) and RSAFS (durable goods orders) signal robust demand, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, driving positive 5-day forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and RSAFS rises simultaneously
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS rise together but 5-day returns remain negative, or their combined effect is offset by other factors (e.g., high inflation).
